title: Local equality of bounded finite free chain maps
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and P a cochain complex of O_Y-modules [def-pc-derived-category], supported in [0,d], d in N, with finite free terms [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let U<=V be opens in Y, and y in U. Let K be P first restricted to V and then to U along Y.homOfLE(U<=V). Let a,b:K -> K be fixed chain maps. Suppose their termwise pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback] along U.fromSpecStalkOfMem(y) are equal. Then there is W<=U containing y on which the restrictions of a,b along Y.homOfLE(W<=U) are equal as chain maps. No homotopy or lifting of a map is asserted.

source.place: Proof, first two paragraphs: local unit-entry cancellation and extension of the finite calculation; finite matrix homotopy identities after shrinking

proof.text: For each degree n, choose the finite free isomorphism of P.X n, restrict it twice, and compose with restrictFreeIso at each restriction and its inverse along U.ι. This identifies the degree-n source of the twice-restricted complex with the restriction to U of a finite free module on Y. Extract degree n from the equality of pulled-back chain maps. Apply exists_restrict_eq_of_pullback_eq with both its opens equal to U, obtaining a neighborhood on which a.f n and b.f n agree.

proof.text: Induct on a finite set of degrees. For the empty set use U. For insertion intersect the previously obtained neighborhood with the new degree neighborhood. Equality persists after shrinking: restrictFunctorCongr and restrictFunctorComp identify direct restriction with iterated restriction, and naturality transports the equality.

proof.text: Apply the finite-set result to the integer interval [0,d]. Outside this interval the source terms are zero by the strict support hypotheses and preservation of strict support by restriction. Maps from zero objects agree, and restricting their equality gives equality of components. Within the interval use the finite-set result. HomologicalComplex.hom_ext assembles the component equalities into equality of chain maps.

theorem exists_shrink_chainMap_eq_of_stalk
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y) (V U : Y.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V) (hyU : y ∈ U)
    (a b :
      (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hUV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
        (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P)) ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hUV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
        (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P)))
    (heq : ((Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map a =
      ((Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map b) :
    ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U), y ∈ W ∧
      ((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWU)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map a =
      ((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWU)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map b
